models.closure: Freeze completed living P,Q,diet,predation,accumulation,migration. Solve EE for SM; detritus accumulation absorbs routed inflow at fixed predation. No new consumption is assumed.
models.group_identity_source: UTF-8 frozen JSON group_seq/group_name; immutable numeric sequence.
limitations: All source harvest fields are explicit zero; every designated discard amount is zero. This control cannot support a regional sensitivity envelope.
NE is the source Ecopath model label, not an established northeast subregion; source represents the Sea of Okhotsk in the 1980s.
models.baseline_validation: Frozen original saved workbook and overlapping original solved study points.
